bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Unaudited interim financial statements 'As at 30 September 2025' -- the LAST quarterly filing GIB published as a standalone reporting entity before being absorbed into the Bangladesh Bank-brokered 'Sammilito Islami Bank PLC' merger (Letter of Intent 9 November 2025; Sammilito began independent operations 18 August 2026; see sources.json and the project_sammilito_islami_bank_merger memory note). Same fully-restated basis as 2025_Q1/Q2.json. Equity deepened further to -43,840.37m (from -37,847.30m at Jun-2025), a further quarterly loss of -5,993.07m. Cumulative Jan-Sep 2025 EPS of -22.63 matches, to the second decimal, the figure already on record in this dataset's own sources.json ('DSE's own company page... shows... 9-month cumulative EPS -22.63'), independently corroborating this filing as the correct primary source for GIB's terminal quarter. Total 9-month cumulative loss (-22,348.01m) already nearly double the entire FY2024 audited annual loss (-12,466.18m), all incurred across three quarters of 2025 that never received a corresponding annual report before the bank's merger absorption. Cross-check: Q1 PAT (-7,411.90m) + Q2 discrete PAT (-8,943.05m) + Q3 discrete PAT (-5,993.07m) = -22,348.02m, matching this filing's own cumulative 9-month PAT (-22,348.01m) to within 0.01m of rounding. This dataset's GIB series ends here: no FY2025 annual report / Q4 filing exists or will exist for GIB as a standalone entity (confirmed independently three ways in a prior session, see sources.json's 'confirmed_nonexistent' entry) -- any FY2025 annual comparison for GIB must use these Q1-Q3 interim figures, as there is no Q4/audited annual counterpart and there never will be.
